## GetNotificationPreferences

`POST /spin.v1.SettingsService/GetNotificationPreferences`

Which of those the caller is emailed about.

**Request**

No fields: `{}`.

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `preferences` | list of [NotificationPreference](/reference/api/types/#notificationpreference) | One per event a person may be told of, in the order they are shown. |
| `emailConfigured` | boolean |  |

## ListNotifications

`POST /spin.v1.SettingsService/ListNotifications`

What happened to the caller's workspaces that they are told of, newest first, with whether each was sent and how. Recorded whether or not the installation can send email.

**Request**

No fields: `{}`.

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `notifications` | list of [Notification](/reference/api/types/#notification) |  |
| `emailConfigured` | boolean | Whether the installation can send email at all. |
